issue.title: Task requirements wear the criterion diamond
issue.description: Every task requirement is drawn with one quiet, constant-width diamond in its owner's ink, at every depth, in Obsidian, Bob Mac Capture, the successor cards, and CLI text. The mark's fill shows the requirement's state, indentation alone shows its depth, and the Mac draft shows honest bytes. Nothing about how requirements behave, are stored, or are typed changes.
